name: Batch Upsert Companies
description: Upsert a batch of companies in Hubspot. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/crm/objects/companies#post-%2Fcrm%2Fv3%2Fobjects%2Fcompanies%2Fbatch%2Fupsert)

configurable_props.name: infoAlert
configurable_props.content: Create or update companies identified by a unique property value as specified by the `idProperty` query parameter. `idProperty` query param refers to a property whose values are unique for the object. To manage properties in Hubspot, navigate to your Settings -> Data Management -> Properties.

configurable_props.name: inputs
configurable_props.label: Inputs (Companies)
configurable_props.description: Provide a **list of companies** to be upserted. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/reference/api/crm/objects/companies#post-%2Fcrm%2Fv3%2Fobjects%2Fcompanies%2Fbatch%2Fupsert) for more information. Example: `[ { "idProperty": "unique_property", "id": "123", "properties": { "name": "CompanyName" } } ]`
